rules.sentence: Prednisolone 15 to 30 mg daily, a systemic corticosteroid, is the most common treatment for pustular psoriasis of pregnancy.
The dose may be increased to prednisolone 60 to 80 mg daily if needed.
Topical betamethasone 0.05% at a dose of 15 to 30 grams per day has also been used.
Dapsone, H1-receptor antagonists, and colchicine have been tried.
Acitretin has been successfully used in postpartum women.
